title: Nonprofit Grant Pipeline Tracker
target_customer: Small nonprofits, 501(c)(3) staff, program directors and independent grant applicants who track their own funding pipeline
problem: Grant deadlines, reporting obligations and award conditions are missed because they live in three places (a calendar, an inbox and a spreadsheet nobody updates), and a missed report can put an award at risk

demand_signals.signal: This is the only candidate in the 2026-10-19 research pass with review counts in the hundreds on the exact same product concept and file format.
demand_signals.evidence: Etsy market page for 'grant tracking spreadsheet' shows a Nonprofit Grant Tracker Spreadsheet (Excel & Google Sheets) with (982) reviews at $15.00 (from a $30.00 list), and a second at (137) reviews for $19.97 (from $39.95).
demand_signals.interpretation: Proven, repeated, high-volume willingness to pay for a grant-pipeline workbook - the strongest demand artifact found in this pass.

demand_signals.signal: At least one comparable publishes a real sales count.
demand_signals.evidence: Etsy listing 4462870544 ('Grant Tracker Spreadsheet for Nonprofits ... 501c3') states '4.9 (27) - 203 sales - 1 year on Etsy' (price displayed only in JPY on the geo-served page; no USD figure asserted).
demand_signals.interpretation: The category converts, not just accumulates reviews.

demand_signals.signal: The concept is bought in three different formats at $15-$20, including one Gumroad workbook bundle almost identical in shape to what we plan to ship.
demand_signals.evidence: GRANTFLOW ($15.92, Gumroad: 2 XLSX + 4 PDF guides + 250 prepared rows) and two Gumroad checkout pages showing 'Grant Budget and Reporting Tracker - Excel Workbook' at US$19 and a Notion grant tracker at US$15.
demand_signals.interpretation: A workbook-plus-guide bundle in this niche is a normal, already-selling product shape at a price we can meet.

demand_signals.signal: Buyers with budget exist above the template price band.
demand_signals.evidence: GrantCompass sells a 17-resource Canadian grant bundle at $67 (from $97), explicitly positioned against 'Hire a Grant Writer $2,000+', and states it was built from 224 analysed programs (page updated February 2026).
demand_signals.interpretation: The niche is not purely price-driven; depth commands an order of magnitude more than an Etsy template.

demand_signals.signal: A high price without reputation does not sell in this niche.
demand_signals.evidence: Etsy listing 4481454002 prices a grant award management spreadsheet at USD 111.25 and shows 'No reviews yet - 0 sales - Listed on Apr 1, 2026'.
demand_signals.interpretation: The $39.00 manifest price cannot be assumed; it must be earned by content depth and proven by the factory's own gates. Recorded as a caution, not a target.

demand_signals.signal: The closest competitor states the same non-promise we must make, which is evidence of the category's honest disclosure norm.
demand_signals.evidence: GRANTFLOW's own page: 'This template does not submit applications or guarantee funding.'
demand_signals.interpretation: Any product we ship must carry the equivalent disclosure (no funding guaranteed, not legal/financial advice) - it is a market norm, not optional hedging.

competition_note: Etsy and Google-Sheets-first templates dominate; at least 6 Etsy listings and 4 Gumroad/direct products were observed for this exact concept in one search pass. Competition is real but the category is proven to pay.
differentiation_note: The winning differentiation is not a new concept - it is depth and correctness: a deadline/report-cadence engine that computes what is actually due (like B12-005's cadence logic), a status pipeline with real conditional logic, plus a written method. The market's most-reviewed entry is a plain tracker, so computation is where a small seller can still win.

comparable_band_usd.note: Observed single-file workbooks on Etsy/Gumroad: $6.98, $15.00, $15.92, $17.24, $19.00, $19.97. Bundles reach $67.

price.price_basis: NOT_YET_DERIVED - no gate has been run for B12-010 in this round
price.rationale: The manifest's $39.00 is ABOVE every observed single-file comparable ($6.98-$19.97) and is not supported by this evidence. Per the Cycle 99 pricing rule the price will be derived after the deliverable is rebuilt to the deep-QA bar and the factory's own gates are run - including the page/depth market-realism policy, which will bind hard for a workbook-only product. No price is proposed or charged now.

real_alternatives_for_a_zero_budget_buye.alternative: Google Sheets / Excel templates already bundled with grant-writing guides
real_alternatives_for_a_zero_budget_buye.quote: the same Etsy result page mixes paid listings with free and low-cost template alternatives
not priced anywhere; standard practice in the sector - a real substitute we must beat on workflow, not on availability
GrantCompass: 'Hire a Grant Writer $2,000+ - Fully done for you - 3-6 week turnaround - Per-application cost'

verified_by: Claude (live web search, 2026-10-19; prices read off the live listing/checkout pages)
honest_caveats: The 982-review figure is the review count displayed against that listing on the Etsy market page; it is the strongest demand signal observed, but it measures accumulated reviews, not current monthly sales.
Two listings display prices only in JPY because of the geo-served page; no USD conversion is asserted for either.
No sales or revenue for Galaxy Forge is implied anywhere by this evidence. VERIFIED_REVENUE remains $0.00.
